title: Handshake Ledger
one_liner: Inventories a founder-led company's unsigned partner deals and founder-only relationships, then ranks the revenue at risk.
speaker: Salim Ismail
context: Salim's guess at why Jensen was pushed out: billion-dollar partnerships with no signed contracts, an ecosystem centred on one person, nepotism and no succession plan, with the board pressing for things to be written down.
customer: Founder-led private companies with roughly 20–200 staff (distributors, agencies, manufacturers), especially those preparing for investment, a sale or a new COO
problem: Big customer and supplier relationships rest on handshakes and the founder's personal contacts. Nobody knows how much revenue would wobble if the founder left or a partner walked, so buyers, boards and lenders discount the company.
revenue_model: A fixed-fee 2-week inventory sprint of about $3,500–$6,000, with an annual refresh at about $1,500 (estimate). The finished ledger goes to the client's own lawyer for any contract drafting.
why_now: The NVIDIA episode made key-person risk and unsigned mega-deals a headline topic. The hosts expect boards and Congress to dig into who promised what, which raises the value of having things written down.
first_steps: Build a one-page ledger template (partner, revenue share, signed or unsigned, relationship owner, backup contact, renewal date)
Fill it in for 2 friendly small businesses for free and record how much revenue turned out to be unsigned or founder-only
Pitch the fixed-fee sprint to 15 M&A advisors and fractional CFOs as a pre-diligence add-on
cost_to_start: About 1 week and near-zero cash: a template, a sample report and outreach (estimate).
competition: Lawyers, fractional COOs and due-diligence firms cover parts of this, usually at higher cost and only during a deal (unverified).
risks: It can drift into legal advice, so it must stay an inventory and referral. Founders may resist exposing their dependence on themselves. Overlap with general diligence services may push prices down.

tool.title: Handshake Exposure Map
tool.one_liner: Paste your key partners and see what share of revenue rests on unsigned deals or a single person.
tool.demo: The user pastes or types rows of partner, annual revenue, contract status (signed, expired, verbal), relationship owner and backup contact. The tool ranks partners by exposure and shows totals: the percentage of revenue that is unsigned, founder-only or has no backup. It also produces a printable action list ordered by risk for the founder to take to their lawyer.
tool.data_plan: Entirely the customer's own input (pasted CSV or form rows), with a bundled fictional example company. No external data.
acceptance: Pasting the example CSV and pressing Map ranks the partners and shows the percentage of revenue that is unsigned, single-owner and missing a backup contact
Changing one partner's status from 'verbal' to 'signed' immediately updates the totals and the ranking
Example mode loads a fictional company and labels it 'Example data'
The action list is printable and includes a note that it is not legal advice
Table and totals are readable on a phone, with no horizontal scroll on the summary
